title: diff between a prerelease and a stable version
issue_text:
`semver.diff` reports the wrong level going from a prerelease to a release on a later minor

I was using `semver.diff` to classify an upgrade from a prerelease build to a stable version on the next minor line:

```js
const semver = require('semver')
semver.diff('3.4.6-2', '3.5.2') // returns 'patch'
```

That looks wrong to me. The minor number has gone from 4 to 5, so I expected `'minor'`.
